parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).

Where does the woman hurt?

parts.title: Listening - Part 4 (Short Extracts Multiple Choice)
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: You will hear two friends talking. Where are they?
You will hear a woman talking about her friend. What does her friend want?

options.A: her son to become a doctor
options.B: her son to stop playing football

questions.question: You will hear a police officer talking to a man. What’s the problem?

options.C: The man is a new driver.

questions.question: You will hear a woman talking to her son about school. What is she telling him?

options.A: He must try harder at school.
options.B: He may have to stop working.
options.C: He should talk to his teacher.

questions.question: You will hear two colleagues talking at the office. Why is the man tired?

options.A: He had to work on his talk.
options.C: He has delayed at the office.
